judgment_text:
Prayer : Criminal Original Petition is filed under Section 528 of BNSS Act, 2023, to accept the surrender of the petitioners before the Special Court for SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act i.e., the 1st Additional District and Sessions Judge at Thanjavur in Connection with the Crime No. 54 of 2026 on the file of the 2nd respondent police and to consider the bail application filed by the petitioners on the same day.

ORDER

1. The present petition has been filed by the accused persons in Crime No. 54 of 2026 on the file of the second respondent police seeking a direction to the learned Special Court for SC/ST, (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, i.e., the I Additional District and Sessions Court, Thanjavur.

2. According to the learned Counsel for the petitioners, the petitioners have been implicated in a criminal case in crime No. 54 of 2026 and they sought for a direction as against the concerned trial Court seeking the direction to consider their bail application on the date of surrender.

3. Considering the above said facts, there shall be a direction to the Special Court for SC/ST, (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, Thanjavur, to consider the bail application of the petitioners in crime No. 54 of 2026 on the date of surrender after giving due opportunity to the defacto complainant.

4. With the above said observations, this Criminal Original Petition stands allowed.
